texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: 1. Overview
texts.text: 1. Overview

texts.label: text
texts.orig: This guide describes how a new employee is onboarded, which systems they are granted access to, and who approves each step. It is synthetic test content generated for a document-ingestion experiment.
texts.text: This guide describes how a new employee is onboarded, which systems they are granted access to, and who approves each step. It is synthetic test content generated for a document-ingestion experiment.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Every role named in this document is fictional. No real employee, client, or system from any production environment is referenced.
texts.text: Every role named in this document is fictional. No real employee, client, or system from any production environment is referenced.

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: 1.1 Purpose
texts.text: 1.1 Purpose

texts.label: text
texts.orig: The purpose of this section is to state that onboarding is completed within five working days of the joining date, and that the approving manager is recorded in the access matrix.
texts.text: The purpose of this section is to state that onboarding is completed within five working days of the joining date, and that the approving manager is recorded in the access matrix.

texts.orig: 2. Onboarding Steps
texts.text: 2. Onboarding Steps

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: HR creates the employee account in the HR portal.
texts.text: HR creates the employee account in the HR portal.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: The manager assigns the employee to a delivery project.
texts.text: The manager assigns the employee to a delivery project.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: IT issues the laptop and provisions repository access.
texts.text: IT issues the laptop and provisions repository access.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: Payroll adds the employee to the monthly salary cycle.
